videos.title: Dabangg
videos.description: The biggest hit of Hindi cinema in recent times, this high-voltage tongue-in-cheek crime caper tells the story of Chulbul Pandey, an Uttar Pradesh cop who calls himself Robin Hood Pandey. Chulbul delights in flexing his muscles, picking fights and causing mayhem. Instead of arresting violent thieves, Chulbul happily robs the robbers, keeping the money locked up in his mother's safe.

videos.title: Khoon Bhari Maang
videos.description: Sanjay tricks the wealthy Aarti into marrying him so he can take over her family's estate. After the wedding, he kills her, making it look like an accident, but Aarti survives, and returns to get her revenge.

videos.title: Vanvaas
videos.description: The dynamics between an elderly father grappling with dementia and his family.

videos.title: Kasme Vaade
videos.description: A man lives with his younger brother who hangs out with the wrong crowd. Suddenly things take a tragic turn for the worse.

videos.title: Phool Aur Kante
videos.description: An honest and diligent police inspector's investigations have proved someone is involved in criminal activities, as well as terrorism, and has the full co-operation of some employees in the police department, as well as the Indian army.

videos.title: De De Pyaar De 2
videos.description: Love faces its toughest test yet as Ashish visits Ayesha's family home. Will the age-gap romance win hearts or stir things up?

videos.title: B.A. Pass 2
videos.description: A young woman relocates to Mumbai to evade an arranged marriage. Living alone in the city, she encounters an array of problems.

videos.title: Rashmi Rocket
videos.description: A small-town girl overcomes all societal barriers to become a national-level athlete, but her glory is hindered when she is asked to undergo a gender test.

videos.title: Pure Bollywood
videos.description: A comprehensive compilation of some of the best foot-tapping and popular songs from Bollywood is played back to back to entertain the audience.

videos.title: Mere Pyaare Prime Minister
videos.description: An eight-year-old boy dreams of building an indoor bathroom for his mother and writes to the prime minister of India, asking for help to improve conditions in his poor neighbourhood.

videos.title: Kaho Naa Pyar Hai
videos.description: A young girl meets the Doppelgänger of her deceased boyfriend and now has a chance to find the people who have murdered him.

videos.title: Dil Chahta Hai
videos.description: Life takes three footloose and fancy-free friends on a roller coaster of love and self-discovery after they drift apart following a tumultuous falling-out.

videos.title: No Entry
videos.description: A gorgeous club dancer's ill-timed rendezvous opens up a Pandora's box of lies, absurdities and misunderstandings in the lives of three quirky couples.

videos.title: Zeher
videos.description: A Police Inspector is married to her subordinate, and both are employed by the Goa Police Force. They share a fairly harmonious relationship until a woman goes missing and is believed dead. To add to the mystery, there is also the question of a missing suitcase full of cash.

videos.title: Krazzy 4
videos.description: A psychiatrist spends the majority of his time treating four patients, but he becomes so involved in their lives that his wife attempts to get rid of them.

videos.title: Pure Bollywood
videos.description: A comprehensive compilation of some of the best foot-tapping and popular songs from Bollywood is played back to back to entertain the audience.

videos.title: Bareilly Ki Barfi
videos.description: Set in the small town of Bareilly, Bitti is a free-spirited young girl who lives life on her own terms and refuses to be pressured into getting married. Her life takes a shift when she meets Chirag Dubey and Pritam Vidrohi.

videos.title: Koi ... Mil Gaya
videos.description: Indian scientist Sanjay Mehra is convinced life exists beyond the earth and manages to send a message into space. When at last he receives an answer, no one believes there may be aliens out there but Sanjay and his pregnant wife, Sonia, see a UFO at first hand. Following a car accident, Sanjay dies and Sonia has their son, Rohit Mehra, but as the boy grows physically, his mind remains that of a child.

videos.title: Ek Deewane Ki Deewaniyat
videos.description: When a powerful politician falls for a strong-willed superstar, their passionate romance quickly spirals into a dangerous game of obsession, pride, and heartbreak.

videos.title: Yamla Pagla Deewana 2
videos.description: A trio reunites in the UK. They fall in love, become involved with a nightclub, and have to face up to the challenge of a local don.

videos.title: Singh Is King
videos.description: Happy Singh is a villager who goes through a chain of misadventures that lead him to become the King of the underworld. He falls in love with Sonia, who hates criminals.

videos.title: Super Singh
videos.description: A man's life changes after he unknowingly gets superpowers & then embarks on a journey that helps him discover true meaning of love, life, courage, sacrifice, & his role in the world.

videos.title: Saaho
videos.description: A man uses an arsenal of weapons to battle a gang of heavily armed thugs in the city. With the city under fire and people's lives at risk, the one man has to give everything he has got to take the city back.

videos.title: Raksha Bandhan
videos.description: Lala Kedarnath, a chaat shop seller, strives to keep his promise to his ailing mother to find suitable husbands for his four sisters, as only then can he marry his childhood love.

videos.title: Taal
videos.description: On a sightseeing road trip of India, a man falls for the daughter of a singer. In time, she falls for him too. Her dad approves of the man, so both go to Bombay to meet his family. On their arrival, they are shunned and treated as second class citizens. This lasts throughout the day, with the treatment getting worse at every point.

videos.title: Radhe: Your Most Wanted Bhai
videos.description: After taking the dreaded gangster Gani Bhai, ACP Rajveer Shikawat, also known as Radhe, goes on a manhunt to find the wealthiest man of the town secretly running a crime syndicate.

videos.title: Bombay to Goa
videos.description: Mala, a young girl, witnesses a murder and boards a Goa-bound bus to escape from the killer. The bus is full of exciting people from different cultures, who make the journey adventurous.

videos.title: Gadar: Ek Prem Katha
videos.description: A Sikh trucker and an aristocratic Muslim woman fall in love against the backdrop of the 1947 partition.

videos.title: A Flying Jatt
videos.description: Aman, a meek young man who is scared of heights, discovers his superpowers during a fight with Raka, a greedy industrialist's ally who becomes a beast bent on destroying the world.

videos.title: Kesari
videos.description: A Sikh havildar and his soldiers put their lives on the line to protect Saragarhi from the Afghans. The battle goes down in history as a shining example of their valour.
